text:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT 2109876543 - KV cache backend: continuous-batching throughput spike detected for tenant slice 'eu-1'. Error rate rising ~3.2% -> 7.8% over last 10m. Auto-mitigation did not reduce amplification. Paging Marco Diaz (on-call).
Marco Diaz: I'm up. Pulling metrics now. link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/kv-cache/continuous-batching?orgId=1&var-tenant=eu-1
Marco Diaz: Observed sustained KV cache miss amplification + large write amplification from prefix growth. P50 latency bumped 120ms -> 550ms for eu-1. Many requests falling back to slower path.
Priya Singh: @Marco any customer-facing incidents reported? CS slack channel quiet so far, but Alerting shows 6 errors correlated to tenant: eu-1-account-42
Rita Patel: CS here — received three escalations, one customer reported timeouts on embeddings endpoint. They've escalated to account team. I'm standing by for status to forward.
Alice Chen: Looking at runtime logs: see this pattern repeating:
```
2026-03-15T02:22:11Z ERROR kv_cache: prefix_eviction_loop took 312ms tenant=eu-1 shard=9 batch_window=128
2026-03-15T02:22:11Z WARN  batching: continuous_batching_queue_len=1200 tenant=eu-1
```
Alice Chen: batch_window for eu-1 is currently 128 (auto-suggested) — suspect continuous batching config + cold KV growth => cache blowout.
Daniel Kim: Oncall suggestion: roll back batch window for that tenant to previous stable 32, and enable per-tenant rate cap on batching. We'll do canary to 5% of affected tenants before moving wider.
Marco Diaz: I will trigger per-tenant override now. Command:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://flags.redwood.example/api/override \
  -d '{"flag":"continuous_batch.window","tenant":"eu-1","value":32,"reason":"live mitigation - kv cache blowup"}'
```
deploy-bot: @Marco override request accepted. Flag change queued to the config service. Rollout ID: ro-9876
feature-flag-bot: Canary plan available: rollout ro-9876 -> start -> target tenants=[eu-1] -> percent=100 for specified tenant. No global canary needed. ETA config push 12s.
Marco Diaz: Confirmed applied. KV cache metrics re-evaluating.
Alice Chen: After override, immediate drop on batching queue: queue_len 1200 -> 320, p50 latency 550ms -> 200ms. Error rate falling. Logs show fewer prefix_eviction events.
Priya Singh: Good signal. Rita, can you update CS with the mitigation steps so they can inform the customer? Also ask if they can keep sending any traces.
Rita Patel: Will update. Drafting message: "We applied a runtime configuration change to reduce batch_window to 32 for your tenant; monitoring shows request latencies improving. We'll continue to monitor and follow up." Will send now.
Marco Diaz: Earlier theory still stands: combination of continuous batching + recent traffic spike from eu-1-account-42 produced large effective prefix lifespan and oversized KV allocations.
Daniel Kim: Next steps: 1) Create hotfix that changes default batch window heuristics under high prefix growth (fallback to 32 when prefix growth > threshold). 2) Add per-tenant runtime guard to cap max batch window to 64 until tested. 3) Ship canary to 1% of tenants, monitor for 30m.
Alice Chen: I can prepare the hotpatch. Minimal diff:
```
// runtime/batching/heuristics.py
if prefix_growth_rate > 0.1 and tenant.has_high_kv_ratio():
    target_window = min(target_window, 32)
```
Alice Chen: Will open PR and deploy to staging canary cluster.
Marco Diaz: While code works through PR, should we widen the per-tenant override to other impacted tenants? We currently only changed eu-1.
Daniel Kim: Do a scoped check: query top 20 tenants by queue_len and add overrides for those with queue_len > 500 and error rate > 2%. Marco, can you run script to produce candidate list?
Marco Diaz: Running query -> producing list now. Output:
```
tenant eu-1 queue_len=1200 err=7.8%
tenant ap-2 queue_len=780 err=3.1%
tenant na-7 queue_len=520 err=2.7%
```
Marco Diaz: I will apply per-tenant overrides for ap-2 and na-7 to batch_window=32 as emergency stop-gap.
deploy-bot: Overrides queued: ro-9877 (ap-2), ro-9878 (na-7). ETA 8s.
feature-flag-bot: Note: Per-tenant overrides are additive; remember to record rollback plan.
Priya Singh: I'll take ownership of communication: post an incident summary to #incidents and #customer-success with current mitigation and action items.
Rita Patel: Customer message sent and acknowledged. They appreciate the quick action.
Alice Chen: PR opened: #4523 - "hotfix: cap batch_window when prefix-growth detected". CI green. Planning to deploy to canary region next.
Daniel Kim: Deploy cadence: canary to 1% (non-prodish cluster) for 10m, then 5% of production tenants (low-traffic slice) for 30m, then escalate if stable. Ensure rollback playbook ready.
Marco Diaz: Kicking off canary deploy to staging cluster (canary job id can-1122). Monitoring dashboards pinned.
incident-bot: Deploy can-1122 started at 2109876720 by Marco Diaz
Marco Diaz: All green in staging after 8m. CPU/RAM stable, no regressions in unit tests.
Alice Chen: Rolling to 5% production slice (tenant slice: low-traffic). Will watch p50/p95, queue_len, prefix_eviction metrics. Hooking up traces to the eval dashboard.
feature-flag-bot: Rolling PR #4523 using rollout rl-3344 -> targets: slice-low-traffic-5pct. Timeout 30m.
Marco Diaz: After ~12m into production canary: small transient spike in ap-east region but within expected. p50 improved for canary tenants. No new errors.
Priya Singh: CS: customers on canary slice reported no new issues.
Daniel Kim: Given positive canary, proceed to staged rollout to top-20 affected tenants with per-tenant override removed (they'll get algorithmic capnd). We'll coordinate with ops for staggered windows.
Marco Diaz: Staged rollout to remainder of affected tenants done in 10-min waves. Monitoring remains green.
Alice Chen: Patching logs:
```
2026-03-15T03:05:10Z INFO batching: applied heuristic cap for tenant=ap-2 target_window=32
2026-03-15T03:05:10Z INFO batching: applied heuristic cap for tenant=na-7 target_window=32
```
Marco Diaz: Metrics summary after full rollout to flagged tenants (30m window): p50 latency improved by median 60%, error rate down from 7% -> 1.2% for those tenants, queue_lengths back to baseline.
Rita Patel: CS confirmed: primary complainant's operations returned to normal and follow-up ticket opened to discuss long-term config.
Daniel Kim: Follow-ups assigned: - Alice: open RFC for heuristics and add unit/regression tests. - Marco: write automation to detect prefix-growth > threshold and auto-create per-tenant override. - Priya: incident writeup to #incidents and handoff notes.
Priya Singh: I'll draft the postmortem with timeline, root cause = heuristic interaction between continuous batching and sudden prefix growth; mitigation = hotpatch + per-tenant overrides; follow-ups as Daniel listed.
Marco Diaz: Handing off to night oncall @PriyaSingh. All metrics stable for 45m. Leaving a pager watch for 2h.
Priya Singh: Taking handoff. Key things to watch: queue_len, p50/p95, prefix_eviction_rate for top 50 tenants. Escalate to Daniel or Alice if error rate > 3% for any tenant.
incident-bot: Incident marked: "mitigated" at 2109877200 by Marco Diaz. Incident ticket: INC-2026-0332
Priya Singh: Thanks team. Good job. I'll finish the incident note and ping product for RFC sync.
